rules.title: AE collection candidate
rules.summary: Collect an adverse-event candidate when an event term is reported.

actions: AE candidate is present; verify the original record and event term.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: collect an AE candidate when an event term is reported.

rules.title: AE grade criterion candidate
rules.summary: Identify a grade toxicity candidate from the project criteria.

actions: Candidate grade 3 toxicity criterion; verify the grade with the investigator.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: a true grade criterion is only a candidate until investigator confirmation.

rules.title: SAE seriousness candidate
rules.summary: Review SAE criteria separately from toxicity grade.

actions: Candidate SAE criteria; verify the serious determination and reporting obligation.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: grade does not replace the separate serious-adverse-event assessment.

rules.title: Investigator relatedness
rules.summary: Request the investigator's separate relatedness assessment.

actions: Review the investigator relatedness assessment and its rationale.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: relatedness requires a separate investigator assessment.

rules.title: Expectedness against the adopted IB
rules.summary: Assess expectedness only against the project-adopted reference safety information.

actions: Compare the event with the project-adopted IB version.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: expectedness uses the project-adopted reference safety information.

rules.title: AESI list check
rules.summary: Check the event against the applicable AESI list without replacing SAE assessment.

actions: Check the event term against the applicable AESI list.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: AESI is a separate dimension from SAE seriousness.

rules.title: DLT criteria
rules.summary: Review DLT only when the project DLT criteria and assessment window are available.

actions: Check DLT criteria and the applicable assessment window.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: DLT requires its own criteria and assessment window.

rules.title: Protocol deviation candidate
rules.summary: Review possible protocol deviation criteria and applicable reporting.

actions: Candidate protocol deviation; verify PD criteria, reporting and correction.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: a suspected deviation is a candidate until confirmed.

rules.title: SAE time anchors
rules.summary: Record event, awareness, entry and actual reporting times separately.

actions: Record event, awareness, entry and actual reporting times; apply the project SAE timeline.

rules.quote: Synthetic rule: event, awareness, entry and actual reporting times must remain separate.
